title: 署長信箱
summary: 署長信箱受理防疫政策建議與陳情，依類別分流至權責單位，原則 30 日內回覆；說明不受理事項、個資告知，以及緊急事項請撥 1922。
note: 原型以表單分類對應權責單位後預覽，送出改用 mailto 或複製；正式環境接署內陳情系統

bodyMarkdown:
> **緊急或疫情相關諮詢請撥 1922**（24 小時）；疑似群聚請撥 1922 或通報衛生局。署長信箱非即時服務。

## 受理範圍
- 對本署防疫政策、法規、措施之建議或陳情。
- 對本署服務品質、人員態度之意見。
- 對官網內容、資料開放之建議。

## 不受理事項
- 未具真實姓名或聯絡方式、內容空泛無具體事實者（依《行政院暨所屬機關處理人民陳情案件要點》得不予處理）。
- 同一事由經答覆後重複陳情者。
- 個人病情診斷、用藥建議（請洽醫師或撥 1922）。
- 檢舉不實訊息請至「謠言查證」；回報 AI 問答錯誤請用答案頁「回報」鍵。
- 非本署權責者，將移送權責機關並副知您。

## 處理天數
收件後分送權責單位，**原則 30 日內**回覆；需會辦多單位或調查者，得延長並先行告知。

## 分流類別
| 類別 | 權責單位 | 例如 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 疫苗接種與公費疫苗 | unit.acute-infectious | 接種對象、接種紀錄、疫苗不良事件 |
| 急性傳染病（登革熱、流感、腸病毒、麻疹等） | unit.acute-infectious | 疾病防治措施、病例定義 |
| 結核病、愛滋與性傳染病 | unit.chronic-infectious | 都治、匿名篩檢、PrEP |
| 國際旅遊與邊境檢疫 | unit.quarantine | 旅遊疫情建議、黃皮書、入境檢疫 |
| 醫療機構與長照機構感染管制 | unit.infection-control | 院內感染、查核申訴 |
| 檢驗與實驗室生物安全 | unit.lab | 送驗、檢驗結果、感染性生物材料 |
| 統計資料與開放資料 | unit.epidemic-intelligence | 資料集、NIDSS、資料申請 |
| 官網使用、無障礙與系統問題 | unit.it | 網頁無法開啟、無障礙、通報系統帳號 |
| 新聞、媒體與宣導素材 | unit.pr | 新聞稿、宣導影片、Banner |
| AI 問答與資料治理 | unit.oasis | AI 答錯、白名單、詞彙 |
| 其他／不確定 | unit.secretariat | 由秘書室收文後分案 |

（權責單位以單位代碼表示，頁面呈現時由主檔轉為單位名稱。）

## 個人資料蒐集告知
依《個人資料保護法》第 8 條告知：本署為處理您的陳情（特定目的：一般行政、陳情請願案件處理），蒐集您提供之姓名、電子郵件、電話及陳情內容；僅於處理期間及依檔案法保存年限內，於本署及受移送之權責機關利用。您可依法請求查詢、閱覽、更正或刪除；如不提供必要資料，將無法回覆。

en.title: Director-General’s mailbox
en.summary: Submit policy suggestions or complaints; messages are routed to the responsible unit and answered within 30 days in principle. Call 1922 for urgent matters.
en.bodyMarkdown:
> **For urgent or outbreak-related enquiries, call 1922** (24 hours); to report a suspected cluster, call 1922 or notify the health bureau. The Director-General's mailbox is not a real-time service.

## What we accept
- Suggestions or petitions about Taiwan CDC's disease prevention policies, regulations and measures.
- Comments on the quality of service or the conduct of staff.
- Suggestions about the website content and open data.

## What we do not accept
- Petitions without a real name or contact details, or vague ones without concrete facts (they may be left unprocessed under the Executive Yuan's Guidelines for Handling Petitions to Agencies).
- Repeat petitions on the same matter after a reply has been given.
- Personal diagnosis or medication advice (please see a physician or call 1922).
- To report false information, go to "Rumor check"; to report an error in an AI answer, use the "Report" button on the answer page.
- Matters outside Taiwan CDC's remit will be referred to the competent authority, with a copy to you.

## Processing time
Messages are routed to the responsible unit after receipt, and **as a rule are answered within 30 days**; matters that need several units or an investigation may take longer, and you will be told in advance.

## Routing categories
| Category | Responsible unit | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Vaccination and publicly funded vaccines | Division of Acute Infectious Diseases | Eligibility, vaccination records, vaccine adverse events |
| Acute infectious diseases (dengue, influenza, enterovirus, measles, etc.) | Division of Acute Infectious Diseases | Disease control measures, case definitions |
| Tuberculosis, HIV and sexually transmitted infections | Division of Chronic Infectious Diseases | DOTS, anonymous screening, PrEP |
| International travel and border quarantine | Division of Quarantine | Travel health notices, yellow card, entry quarantine |
| Infection control in medical and long-term care facilities | Division of Infection Control and Biosafety | Hospital-acquired infections, audit appeals |
| Laboratory testing and biosafety | Center for Diagnostics and Vaccine Development | Specimen submission, test results, infectious biological materials |
| Statistics and open data | Epidemic Intelligence Center | Datasets, NIDSS, data requests |
| Website use, accessibility and system problems | Information Management Office | Pages that will not open, accessibility, reporting-system accounts |
| News, media and publicity materials | Public Relations Office | Press releases, videos, banners |
| AI answers and data governance | Office of AI Strategy, Innovation, and Synergy (OASIS) | Wrong AI answers, whitelist, glossary |
| Other / unsure | Secretariat Office | Registered by the Secretariat, then assigned |

## Notice on the collection of personal data
Notice under Article 8 of the Personal Data Protection Act: to handle your petition (specific purposes: general administration, handling of petitions), Taiwan CDC collects the name, email address, telephone number and petition content you provide. They are used only during processing and for the retention period under the Archives Act, by Taiwan CDC and any competent authority to which the matter is referred. You may, as provided by law, request to inquire about, review, correct or delete your data; if you do not provide the necessary data, we will not be able to reply.
